edition: The World Today — One Image Edition
compiled: Compiled from wire reports filed 21–22 Nov 2026, as of 03:20 UTC

lead.headline: Russian Missiles Hit Polish Soil; Trump Calls It a Mistake
lead.deck: Poland says Russian missiles struck its territory in the gravest spillover of the Ukraine war so far. NATO chief Mark Rutte vowed the alliance “will defend every inch of Polish territory”, while President Trump called the strike a mistake — leaving allies weighing how hard to respond.

second.headline: Iranian Attack Sets Bahrain Industrial Site Ablaze
second.deck: Bahrain reported no injuries after an Iranian attack set fire to an industrial facility; Tehran's IRGC said it targeted US military positions at bases in al-Riffa and Awali. Iran also struck three tankers as Houthi attacks continued across the region.

stories.h: Russian Cargo Ship Ablaze in Baltic After Drone Strike
stories.d: The crew fled a burning Russia-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland; Finland's PM: war is “spilling over”.

stories.h: Fossil-Fuel Fight Leaves COP31 Climate Talks in Deadlock
stories.d: Nearly 200 countries are deadlocked over a fossil-fuel phaseout, with diplomats racing for a compromise as the summit teeters on failure.

stories.h: EU and Indonesia Sign Landmark Trade Deal
stories.d: Brussels and Jakarta signed a free-trade agreement after a decade of talks, covering goods from palm oil to pharmaceuticals.

stories.h: Cartel Boss “El Chapo Isidro” Captured in Sinaloa Shoot-Out
stories.d: Mexican special forces arrested Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, an FBI 10 Most Wanted fugitive who had evaded capture for over a decade.

stories.h: Bolsonaro in Intensive Care With Bowel Obstruction
stories.d: Brazil's former president, serving a sentence for plotting a coup, is stable and breathing on his own, his hospital said.

stories.h: Trump Orders Contractors to Clear Congressional Replies With White House
stories.d: Federal contractors must now clear replies to Congress with the White House — a new order.

stories.h: Bessent Confirms He Is Living on a US Military Base Over Iran Fears
stories.d: The Treasury secretary confirmed the unusual security arrangement as the Iran conflict widens across the Gulf.

stories.h: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Criminal Database
stories.d: The bureau is probing an apparent intrusion into a criminal database, the BBC reported early Saturday.

stories.h: Trump Vows to Work With Democrats to Cap Credit-Card Interest Rates
stories.d: The president pledged bipartisan action on card rates as living-cost protests spread across Europe and the US.

stories.h: China's $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns a Hot Trade Into a Losing Bet
stories.d: US chip curbs hammered Chinese tech stocks; analysts call the bust a “moment of real danger” for Xi.

stories.h: Nvidia Said to Face SEC Probe Into Its Accounting Practices
stories.d: The chip giant is reportedly under scrutiny over its books, even as an associate is accused of funnelling its chips to China.

stories.h: Anthropic IPO Signals “Beginning of a Gold Rush” for Small Business
stories.d: The AI lab's path to public markets is being read as a starting gun for a wave of AI listings and suppliers.

stories.h: Bayer Reaches Roundup Settlement That Could Cost Billions
stories.d: The agreement would settle weedkiller cancer claims that have hung over the German group for years.

stories.h: SpaceX Dragon Cargo Capsule Returns to Earth From the ISS
stories.d: NASA's 35th resupply mission came home packed with science and cargo from the station.

stories.h: BepiColombo Arrives in Orbit Around Mercury After Eight Years
stories.d: The European-Japanese probe looped into orbit around the Sun's innermost planet; its X-ray telescope has already returned first images.

stories.h: Pancreatic Cancer Pill Hailed as “Biggest Breakthrough in Decades”
stories.d: A new drug combination stopped tumour growth in metastatic pancreatic cancer, a disease with few treatment options.

stories.h: Virginia Child Dies in State's First Measles Death of 2026
stories.d: The death comes as a national outbreak costs the US the measles-elimination status it had held for 26 years.

stories.h: France 45–17 Argentina: Les Bleus March Into the Final
stories.d: France beat Los Pumas to set up a Nations Championship final against South Africa.

stories.h: Rutgers Stuns Penn State for First Win Over the Lions Since 1988
stories.d: A last-second lateral near the goal line and a two-point conversion sealed a famous upset.

stories.h: Rams Star Puka Nacua Out 4–5 Months After Knee Surgery
stories.d: The wide receiver will be sidelined for the playoffs in a blow to Los Angeles.

stories.h: NWSL Championship: Washington Spirit Face Kansas City Current
stories.d: The league title is on the line in Saturday's final between the Spirit and the Current.

stories.h: Sacramento Republic Beat Louisville City to Win USL Final
stories.d: Republic FC lifted the USL Championship trophy with victory over Louisville City FC.

stories.h: Teen Gamer and His Mother Help Rescue a Missing Girl
stories.d: A teenager playing online and his quick-thinking mother helped police find a missing girl.

stories.h: Lock of George Washington's Hair Sells for $4,000
stories.d: A lock of the first US president's hair changed hands at auction for four thousand dollars.

stories.h: Miley Cyrus Marries Maxx Morando After Five Years of Dating
stories.d: The singer wed the drummer in a ceremony reported early Saturday.
